name: HORIZONTAL PLANETARY BALL MILL
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-HPBM-8L Horizontal Planetary Ball Mill is specifically engineered for advanced research laboratories to prevent materials from sinking or sticking to the bottom of the grinding jar. Used for challenging synthetic materials, this horizontal design ensures superior fineness and homogenization while adopting high-speed planetary movement with large energy impact.
features: Horizontal design prevents material from sinking or sticking to the bottom
Imported frequency converter precisely controls speed and protects the motor
Adjustable time of forward, reverse rotation, and alternation functions
Maximum four powder samples from different materials can be ground simultaneously
Integrated safety switch stops the machine if the lid is opened while running

specifications.MOC of Jar & Balls: SS304/316, Agate, Nylon, Corundum, Zirconia, Tungsten Carbide
specifications.Target Applications: Advanced Materials Research, Synthetic Chemistry, Nanomaterials
